title: Zephyrine and the Thorn
author: Tamsin Zhou
blurb: Theo Eriksen, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
